scope: First bounded reference campaign; criteria fixed before private final-bank creation.
harness_qualified: All selected sources/weights pass binding and inference admission; exact GPU resume proofs retained; every required fresh assessment game completes naturally with legal deterministic inference in isolated CPU processes.
learned_reference_improvement_qualified: Fresh-bank paired reference-minus-untrained and reference-minus-equal-time-control 95% intervals both have a strictly positive lower endpoint. This is a fixed-panel criterion, not expert strength.
method_replication: Two precommitted v3 training seeds; any additional spatial pilot has one paired training seed and receives only a conditional, non-generalized comparison.
reason_strength_flags_stay_false: Public tactical/scripts/neural opposition has no independent human/expert calibration, and commercial-game fidelity remains unverified.
outcomes: Natural wins/ties/losses, administrative caps, illegal actions, simulator faults, infrastructure faults, request refusals and delayed-run refusals remain separate. Invalid/incomplete evaluation has no aggregate score.
closure: Select a single development-selected stage per family while retaining every precommitted seed; close training before generating and opening a fresh private bank; do not tune afterward.
